booting.text: Morning! Give the desk a second to open up.

no_account.text: Welcome to Branch Zero. First time? Account Opening is the desk with the plant — Ines will sort you out.

text: Morning, {name}. Counter is open and the vault's quiet; Dev can help with a small payment.

text.text: Your bank name {bank_name} is on file — Petra keeps the name desk, and Dev can take it on a payment slip.

pending.text: You've got {pending} wire(s) cooling in the vault. Bob releases them when the clock runs down; Mr. Okafor handles a recall or the early hand-scan route.

hub.text: This is the lobby. Pick an errand and I'll point; the desks do the actual work.

lore_bank.text: Branch Zero keeps its records in the open. Every desk handles a real errand on your account; we just do the paperwork out loud.

lore_bank_tech.text: Your account is a Bloxchain smart account on {chain}. The tellers hold the broadcaster role, the vault is its timelock, and the boards read back from the chain — this branch keeps no clock of its own.

directory.text: The desk map is simple: accounts, payments, and the vault are straight ahead. The other desks are through the side hall.

directory_more.text: These desks keep names, exchange, and the unusual vault work in their own rooms. The small service kiosk can explain the branch too.

payments_vault.text: Small payments go across Dev's counter. Larger wires cool at Bob's vault, while Mr. Okafor handles a recall or the early hand-scan route.

desk_ines.text: Account Opening is the desk with the plant. Ines handles sign-in and the account paperwork; she owns the opening, I only point.

why_privy.text: Ines uses Privy for an embedded wallet you control. With your consent, a scoped session signer is limited to this account's bank slips; she owns the opening, I only point.

desk_counter.text: Dev's Counter handles small payments to approved payees. For anything larger, the slip goes to Bob's vault.

why_counter.text: Under the hood, the slip is a meta-transaction: you sign the instruction, the teller's broadcaster desk submits it and pays gas. Dev's desk owns the payment; I only point.

desk_vault.text: Bob keeps larger wires in the vault for a cooling period. When the clock runs down he releases them; Mr. Okafor handles a recall or an early hand-scan route.

why_vault.text: Big money doesn't move instantly here. It sits in the vault for {timelock}, then Bob releases it; if you change your mind, Mr. Okafor can recall it while it cools.

why_vault_tech.text: Technically, the wire is a Bloxchain time-locked transaction: requested now, executable only after releaseTime, and cancellable until then. The wall clock reads that record; it is not my timer.

desk_manager.text: Mr. Okafor's office handles the unusual vault choices. He can recall a cooling wire or take the hand-scan Priority route; Bob remains the release desk after the clock.

why_manager.text: Priority needs your own hand-scan signature; Okafor only submits it. That skips the cooling clock — it does not replace Bob's timed release, and the silent teller stamp stays out of that path.

text: Petra's Name Desk puts a chosen customer name on your account so people can pay you by it.

text.text: Your bank name {bank_name} is on file; Petra can help with the name desk.

why_ens.text: Technically, Petra registers an ENSv2 subname under branchzero.eth that points at your AccountBlox; the passbook can carry text records too. She owns the name work; I only point.

desk_fx.text: Kenji's FX Desk shows practice-dollar prices for euros and shekels. The exchange lives on the Sepolia wing, and Kenji handles the quote and swap.

why_fx.text: Technically, the board uses guarded Uniswap v4 calls on Sepolia only, with three whitelisted services for the till. Kenji owns the quote and swap; I only point.

service_assistant.text: The service assistant kiosk can explain the branch from a read-only passbook snapshot. It cannot pay, wire, release, recall, open accounts, or change anything.

partners_strip.text: The lobby board carries a partner notice. It is a credit line for the branch, not another desk; ask why if you want the names.

why_partners.text: The ETHOnline pitch partners are Privy, ENS, and Uniswap; Arc is listed as coming soon. That is an event-board credit, not a claim that Branch Zero is an official product of any of them.
